title: Intent-Preserving Adversarial User Simulation for Multi-Turn Agent Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2610.35426v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-turn agents are commonly evaluated with LLM-based simulated users, which can be overly cooperative and can therefore overestimate an agent's performance. We here introduce StressSim, an intent-preserving adversarial user simulator framework for stress-testing agents with challenging yet valid user interactions. StressSim optimises the simulator's high-level adversarial plan for each task instance. Candidate planner prompts are evolved with a genetic prompt-optimisation loop that uses rollout traces, granular task-completion signals, and validity feedback to favour conversations that reduce task success without changing the user's underlying goal. We evaluate the approach on the MultiWOZ dataset and the retail and airline domains from tau-bench with three target LLM agents, comparing against standard simulators and hand-designed non-collaborative user behaviours. translated_title: 面向多轮智能体评估的意图保持对抗性用户模拟
translated_abstract: 多轮智能体通常使用基于大语言模型（LLM）的模拟用户进行评估，但这类模拟用户可能过于配合，从而导致高估智能体的性能。本文提出了StressSim，一个意图保持的对抗性用户模拟器框架，用于通过具有挑战性但仍然有效的用户交互对智能体进行压力测试。StressSim为每个任务实例优化模拟器的高层对抗计划：候选规划器提示词通过遗传提示优化循环进行演化，该循环利用 rollout 轨迹、细粒度的任务完成信号和有效性反馈，倾向于选择那些在不改变用户底层目标的前提下降低任务成功率的对话。我们在MultiWOZ数据集以及tau-bench的零售和航空领域上，使用三个目标LLM智能体对该方法进行了评估，并与标准模拟器以及手工设计的非协作用户行为进行了比较。结果表明StressSim在暴露智能体鲁棒性缺陷方面十分有效。
tldr: 本文提出StressSim，一个意图保持的对抗性用户模拟框架，通过遗传提示优化生成具有挑战性但有效的用户交互，在不改变用户目标的前提下降低任务成功率，从而更真实地暴露多轮LLM智能体的鲁棒性缺陷。
en_tdlr: StressSim is an intent-preserving adversarial user simulation framework that uses genetic prompt optimization to generate challenging yet valid user interactions, reducing task success without altering the user's underlying goal, thereby realistically exposing robustness gaps in multi-turn LLM agents.
